mapper.insert: insert into account( account_id, account_pw, account_nickname, account_birth, account_contact, account_email, account_gender, account_marketing_agree, account_third_party_agree ) values( #{accountId}, #{accountPw}, #{accountNickname}, #{accountBirth}, #{accountContact}, #{accountEmail}, #{accountGender}, #{accountMarketingAgree}, #{accountThirdPartyAgree} )
mapper.select: select attachment_no from account_profile where account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.update: update account set account_login = systimestamp where account_id = #{accountId}

update account
account_pw = #{accountPw},
account_nickname = #{accountNickname},
account_email = #{accountEmail},
account_birth = #{accountBirth},
account_contact = #{accountContact},
account_gender = #{accountGender},
account_change = systimestamp
where account_id = #{accountId}
